runs.hypothesis: Correct forward-facing posture in still first, then limit animation to an unposed café pause.

input.prompt: Six-second candid café pause from the exact reviewed still. Preserve identity, framing, skin texture, clothing and daylight. His head stays naturally aligned with his shoulders, facing forward toward the counter. Eyes rest softly on the coffee in front of him, with one natural brief blink and no eye wandering. He quietly enjoys the stop: gentle breathing and an almost imperceptible settling of his shoulders. Cup stays low in the same relaxed grip, right elbow comfortably supported on the counter; the free hand rests quietly near his waist. Lips remain softly closed. No drinking action, cup lift or head turn. No camera awareness or practiced smile. Locked camera; very small natural motion only.
